cases.constructed: Selective disclosure with hidden-field metadata leakage
cases.proposed_evidence: Compare requested, selected and transmitted attributes; inspect proof and metadata, including payload size. BOR-08 requires cryptographic hiding while SDI-07 permits structural mechanisms; clarify their joint satisfaction rather than treating either in isolation.

cases.constructed: Two verifiers combine repeated presentations and transport metadata
cases.proposed_evidence: Compare randomized proofs across verifiers and test attribute combinations, timing, transport and identifier linkage; protocol-level success alone does not establish resistance to statistical linkage.

cases.constructed: Department can infer presentation from status queries or telemetry despite a no-monitoring policy
cases.proposed_evidence: Inspect data flows, status queries, third-party SDKs, logs and infrastructure telemetry; distinguish prohibited technical capability from lawful exceptions. Reconcile SDI-17 allowance for non-inferable signals with PRV-03 prohibition on Department-bound presentation traffic.

cases.constructed: Wallet obtains per-transaction consent but retains or shares data for a different purpose
cases.proposed_evidence: Inspect consent scope separately from retention purpose and legal basis; test cancellation, deletion, backend sharing and lifecycle data inventory. Consent to presentation is not authorization for unrelated processing.
cases.authority: Wallet Providers and Department; other lifecycle actors under PRV-04

cases.constructed: External verifier requires a privacy-degrading compatibility mode
cases.proposed_evidence: Construct compatible and incompatible interactions; verify refusal rather than downgrade and record access consequences separately under SEDI-01.

cases.constructed: Normal selective presentation with no observed tracking in tested components
cases.proposed_evidence: Positive fixture may support bounded observations; missing architecture or infrastructure evidence cannot establish absence of capability.

limitations: No actual SEDI implementation, profile conformance, telemetry, logs or test execution examined.
Objective coverage transcribed from supplied guide; no risk scoring or guardrail verification.
